items.title: Improve loading screen text clarity
items.what: The text 'Downloading the game' on the loading screen is too small and not prominent (screenshot 1)
items.why: It may cause confusion or frustration if the player is unsure what is happening during the loading process
items.how: Increase the font size and make the text more prominent, e.g., by using a larger font or a different color

items.title: Enhance control label visibility
items.what: The labels 'STANCE' and 'TECHNIQUE' below the control sticks are too small and dim (screenshot 2)
items.why: It may be difficult for players to read the labels, especially in a dimly lit environment or for those with visual impairments
items.how: Increase the font size and brightness of the labels to make them more readable

items.title: Improve moves list readability
items.what: The list of moves in the 'MOVES' menu is too dense and has low contrast (screenshot 6)
items.why: It may be challenging for players to quickly scan and understand the available moves
items.how: Improve the spacing between list items and increase the contrast between the text and background

items.title: Enhance settings menu contrast
items.what: The settings menu has low contrast between the text and background (screenshot 7)
items.why: It may be difficult for players to read the menu options, especially for those with visual impairments
items.how: Increase the contrast between the text and background to make the menu more readable

items.title: Optimize dojo visuals for better composition
items.what: The fighters are positioned too low in the frame, with a significant amount of empty space above them (screenshot 9)
items.why: It may make the game feel less engaging or immersive due to the unbalanced composition
items.how: Adjust the camera position or fighter placement to achieve a more balanced composition
